value.notes: Turn 1: first exploratory run. Checking pause freezing, step, dash, dash recharge (should show Dash 5 after dash, ready after 6 ticks), and dash stop rules. Next: check HUD vs state, pause+move same tick, heart/score caps, spikes, enemy contact, timer, exit flow, dialog buttons.

Turn 2 plan: checking pause+move same tick (should ignore rest of tick, nothing moves), Enter/Escape resume, and whether timer/toasts freeze while paused. Next: spikes at (3,3)/(5,8), heart and gem caps, enemy contact/swap, dash through gate/locked door, timer 0, exit flow, dialog buttons (Restart, Retry, Play again), Enter during pause, click:btn-resume overlap.

Turn 3: testing spikes at (3,3) with score 100 after coin at (4,1). Expect lives 2, score 0 (clamped at 0), then respawn at (1,1) after hit, invulnerable count. Runs so far are benign; need to check spike/respawn behavior next, then timer, dialogs, exit.

Turn 4: testing spikes at (3,3). Path right x3 (coin at 4,1), down x2, left onto spikes (3,3). Expect lives 2, score 0 after 100 coin, respawn (1,1), invulnerable 4 then decrementing. Then check timer, dialogs, exit later. Previous runs benign.

Turn 5. Last run showed score 100 -> 65136 after stepping onto spikes (3,3) from (4,3). Expected score floored at 0 (100-500 -> 0). 65136 = 65536-400, i.e. score wrapped negative. Testing shorter path: down,down,right,right (coin at (1,3) gives 100, then spikes at (3,3)). Next: confirm with score 0 start (no coin) to see if underflow still happens, and check HUD vs state.

reports.title: Spikes at low score wrap score negative to ~65136
reports.observed: Stepping onto spikes with less than 500 points makes score wrap around (e.g. 100 -> 65136) instead of clamping to 0; HUD shows 65136.
reports.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but score never goes below 0, so score should be 0.

value.notes: Confirmed the score-wrap bug on seed 42 with the 4-token run [down, down, right, right]. Score went 0 -> 100 (coin at (1,3)), then the spikes at (3,3) subtracted 500 and the score showed 65136 instead of flooring at 0. Both runs 4 and 5 show the same symptom. Removing any token breaks the path: a missing down leaves (2,2) as a wall, and a missing right means the spikes are never reached. The coin is required to get a positive score first, so the 4-token list is the shortest reproduction I found. No other bugs were observed in the runs so far (HUD matched state, pause and dialog behaviour looked correct in the earlier runs). Not yet explored: exit and dialog flow, time bonus, the timer at 0, heart and 5-life cap, enemy swap collisions, and the gate/lever mechanics. Finishing now given the budget and the single well-confirmed bug.
